title: Yummy Mexican Beef En-Croute Barbacoa
description: This hearty Mexican dish is a twist on traditional Sonoran barbacoa, wrapped in a flaky pastry crust and served with a side of rice vermicelli. It's a comforting meal that's perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, combine the beef brisket, diced onion, minced garlic, beef broth, chili powder, cumin, oregano, and cayenne pepper. Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the beef mixture for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls apart easily.
While the beef is cooking, roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the pastry into four equal pieces, and place each piece on a separate baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
After the beef has finished cooking, remove it from the oven and carefully transfer the pieces of pastry to the pot, pressing them into the bottom and sides to form a crust.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
While the pastry is baking, cook the rice vermicelli according to package instructions and set aside.
Once the pastry is done, carefully remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving with the rice vermicelli.
Season the beef with salt and pepper to taste before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
This recipe makes 4-6 servings, and can be easily doubled or tripled if needed.
You can also make individual servings by using smaller pieces of pastry and portioning out the beef mixture accordingly.
